name: Issachar
title: Jacob's ninth son and the patriarch of the tribe of Issachar
summary: Issachar was the ninth son of the patriarch Jacob and the fifth son of his wife Leah. He became the ancestor of one of Israel's twelve tribes. The tribe of Issachar was known for its wisdom and understanding of the times, and settled in the fertile Jezreel Valley in the Promised Land.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Issachar
keyEvents.description: Leah gave birth to her fifth son and named him Issachar, which means 'reward', because she believed God had rewarded her.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Issachar was among Jacob's sons who traveled down to Egypt with their families when there was a famine in Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Blessing over Issachar
keyEvents.description: On his deathbed, Jacob blessed his sons and described Issachar as a strong donkey that bows under its burden and becomes a servant working hard in a fertile land.

keyEvents.title: Census in the Wilderness
keyEvents.description: During the census at Sinai, the tribe of Issachar was counted as having 54,400 men fit for battle, making it one of the larger tribes.

keyEvents.title: Moses' Blessing over Issachar
keyEvents.description: Moses blessed the tribe of Issachar along with Zebulun and encouraged them to rejoice in their tents and in their journeys.

keyEvents.title: Issachar's Inheritance in Canaan
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Issachar received its inheritance in the fertile area around the Jezreel Valley, which included sixteen cities with surrounding villages.
